en: Colorized illustrated street scene in a historic European city, viewed from above a tree‑lined boulevard that leads into a narrower street with tram tracks. The street is lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with shops and awnings at ground level and elaborate domes, spires, and statues on the roofs. Dominating the right side is a tall Baroque church tower with an onion‑shaped dome and clock. Pedestrians and a tram are visible, suggesting an early‑20th‑century urban atmosphere. No visible text appears on the image side.
